name: Osano
description: Osano is a privacy-management platform for cookie consent, unified consent, subject-rights workflows, data discovery, assessments, vendor management, and privacy compliance operations.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned API key for a dedicated least-privilege Osano user. Selected agents can list only bounded, minimized Cookie Consent configuration metadata. Relay blocks domains, detailed settings, privacy-subject data, publishing, and every mutation.

credentialRequirements.name: OSANO_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Osano API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-owned per-user API key belonging to a dedicated least-privilege Osano user.

capabilities.label: Read consent configurations
capabilities.description: List a bounded, minimized directory of Cookie Consent configurations visible to the API key.

allowed.label: List consent configurations
allowed.description: List up to 20 minimized Cookie Consent configuration records.

blocked.label: Access privacy subjects or change Osano
blocked.description: Domains, detailed configuration, discoveries, rules, subject-rights requests, messages, consents, subjects, assessments, connectors, webhooks, publishing, and every mutation are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One bounded configuration-directory read runs directly; privacy-subject data, detailed settings, and all mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway exposes only a fixed-origin bounded Cookie Consent configuration directory.
Railway exposes only a fixed-origin bounded Cookie Consent configuration directory.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer has supplied an API key for a dedicated least-privilege Osano user, and non-production credential lifecycle acceptance has not been completed.
providerSetup.nextAction: An Osano administrator creates a dedicated least-privilege user permitted only to read Cookie Consent configurations, generates a per-user API key, stores it through Relay's encrypted credential flow, then validates bounded reads, rotation, expiry/revocation, disconnect, rate limiting, and post-disconnect denial in non-production.

evidence.supports: Osano documents fixed api.osano.com v1 endpoints, per-user API keys in x-osano-api-key, pagination, list limits, Cookie Consent configuration reads and writes, discoveries/rules, data discovery, and Subject Rights APIs.
Osano documents a separate Unified Consent API with subject identifiers, consent profiles, consent actions, two API-key types, and mutations; Relay excludes this privacy-subject surface.
Osano warns that disrupting CMP behavior can cause noncompliance and terminate contractual protections, supporting Relay's exclusion of browser-side consent manipulation.
